commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.

90+6' Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) fails to convert the free kick from the edge of the box. His shot goes right into the stands. High, wide and not at all handsome. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
90+5' Le Havre are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
90+2' Laszlo Boloni has decided to substitute Kevin Van Den Kerkhof and he is replaced by Cheikh Sabaly (Metz).
90+2' A brilliant cross into the box finds Arouna Sangante (Le Havre), who directs his header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Loic Nego (Le Havre) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
87' Metz can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

87' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Metz are awarded a corner kick.
84' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) is the one who receives a yellow card.
84' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
81' Luka Elsner prepares a substitution. Yassine Kechta is replaced by Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pape Diallo trots off the pitch and is replaced by Abou Lo (Metz).
80' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) takes the corner.
79' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Le Havre.
78' The referee shows the yellow card to Alexandre Oukidja (Metz).
78' Le Havre have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
77' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) gets to a rebound on the edge of the box and strikes, but he only hits the crossbar and wastes a promising chance.
76' The resulting set piece from Metz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
75' Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) creates some space for himself and unleashes a strike from long range, but his effort sails just wide of the left post.
74' Pape Diallo (Metz) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
72' Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) gets booked for the first time in this match.
72' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
69' Substitution. Daler Kuzyaev makes way for Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre).
69' Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
67' Alexandre Oukidja (Metz) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
66' Alexandre Oukidja (Metz) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
65' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 61:39. The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 1:0.
64' Flag up against Pape Diallo (Metz). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
63' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Antoine Joujou (Le Havre).
61' That will be all from Steve Ngoura who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre).
61' Here is a change. Etienne Youte Kinkoue is going off and Luka Elsner gives the last tactical orders to Antoine Joujou (Le Havre).
61' We are about to witness a substitution. Loic Nego (Le Havre) is replacing Josue Casimir.

60' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
59' Pape Diallo (Metz) is penalised for a foul. Marc Bollengier had a clear view and blows his whistle.
57' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) produces an awful long-range shot that goes high and wide. The game is interrupted now, Josue Casimir (Le Havre) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
56' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the left post. Close!
54' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) does well to evade a couple of challenges then let's fly from distance towards goal, but the effort flies just wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal!
54' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
53' Oualid El Hajjam (Le Havre) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
51' Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is out of play. Metz will take a throw-in.
49' Le Havre are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
47' 0 - 1 Georges Mikautadze (Metz) beats the offside trap and bears down on goal. With just the keeper to beat he coolly shoots past him from the edge of the box.
47' Arthur Desmas pulls off a great save to deny Arthur Atta (Metz), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) displayed very unsporting behaviour.
44' Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
43' CHANCE! Pape Diallo (Metz) fires just wide of the right post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Georges Mikautadze.

41' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
40' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
38' Foul! Maxime Colin (Metz) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Le Havre earn a free kick.
35' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) receives a clever chip pass into a promising position. Nevertheless, one of the defenders is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
33' Kevin N'Doram (Metz) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Referee Marc Bollengier sees the trip by Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
31' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
29' Arthur Atta (Metz) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. It's a free kick to Le Havre, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
27' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
25' Half-chance! Pape Diallo (Metz) plays a pass into the box, but Arthur Desmas reacts well to snuff out the attack. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
23' Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) tries a shot from distance, but the goalkeeper can stay calm as it goes high over the crossbar.

22' Matthieu Udol (Metz) meets a fine cross inside the penalty area from the resulting free kick and attempts to beat the keeper with a sweet header. That he does, but one of the defenders standing on the goal line manages to stop the effort going into the middle of the target. Wasted opportunity. Georges Mikautadze (Metz) gets to the rebound inside the box and smashes the ball just wide of the right post.
21' Tempers flare after Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) commits a foul. He receives a yellow card for his bad challenge and surely must be relieved at not receiving a red card.
20' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 3:0. The shots on goal statistics – 1:0.
17' Oussama Targhalline (Le Havre) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
16' Le Havre get the opportunity to endanger the opposition's goal with a free kick from the edge of the box.
16' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Kevin N'Doram (Metz) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
15' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle after Kevin N'Doram (Metz) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Le Havre get a free kick.
14' Oualid El Hajjam (Le Havre) takes a cheeky throw-in and sets up a counter-attack for his team. The ball is cleared after Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
12' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
11' Le Havre seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
10' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
8' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
6' Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
4' Steve Ngoura (Le Havre) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
3' Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
2' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires the ball from the edge of the box to the top right corner, but Alexandre Oukidja shows his agility and makes a save.
2' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
